verdict.rationale: Sprinto's quickstart docs explicitly claim "one platform, multiple frameworks": SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS and others managed in one place. A Framework Health API suggests framework-level tracking, and a first-party GDPR gap-analysis skill adds some GDPR-specific depth. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on HIPAA and PCI DSS specifically (control mappings, setup workflows), evidence of how adding a new framework reuses existing controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
